A new begining!

Steps & preparation

Site-collected · interpreted game configuration, not fully play-tested

  1. Take the driver’s seat in Meriam’s car; being in the ranch area also satisfies this configured check.
  2. Wait for Meriam to board; the check also accepts reaching the ranch area.
  3. Drive to the ranch area.
  4. At the ranch, both you and Meriam must leave the quest car.
  5. Speak to Meriam. The inventory check requires a Bronze hammer, Red Tent and strawberry, at least one of each.
Before you move on
  • The final inventory check is a completion condition, not a verified reward list.
  • This introductory drive is configured for the farm owner.

From Blueprint to Bed

Steps & preparation

Site-collected · interpreted game configuration, not fully play-tested

  1. Equip the Red Tent blueprint; an already placed or built tent also satisfies the first check.
  2. Place the Red Tent blueprint.
  3. Use the hammer to finish building the tent; placement alone is not the completed-build check.
  4. Sleep while the Red Tent is placed on the ranch.
Before you move on
  • The quest checks the ordinary Red Tent ID, not the four-person tent.

Seeds of Success

Steps & preparation

Site-collected · interpreted game configuration, not fully play-tested

  1. Return to the ranch area.
  2. Equip the hoe; having an existing plantation also passes this check.
  3. Till the soil to create a planting area.
  4. Put seeds in the prepared soil.
  5. Water the seeded soil with the watering can.
  6. Have 16 seeded plots; the last objective and configured condition both use 16.
Before you move on
  • The introductory description says ten plots, but the last objective and condition use 16. Do not stop at ten based only on the description.

Feathered Foes

Steps & preparation

Site-collected · interpreted game configuration, not fully play-tested

  1. Prepare one ordinary Scarecrow or Bob the Scarecrow; the first condition also accepts one already built.
  2. Build one ordinary Scarecrow. This second condition names only the ordinary variant.
Before you move on
  • If the Workbench is still locked, craft the ordinary Scarecrow, not Bob the Scarecrow; the ordinary current-build recipe does not require a workbench.
  • The two checks accept different variants. Bob satisfies the first condition but is not listed in the final build condition.
  • The task introduction describes scarecrows as crop protection against birds; no protection radius is specified here.

Farewell, Nylon Palace!

Steps & preparation

Site-collected · interpreted game configuration, not fully play-tested

  1. Craft and place a storage chest.
  2. Build at least nine house foundations.
  3. Build at least nine standard exterior wall sections.
  4. Build at least two window-wall sections.
  5. Install two windows, in addition to the window walls.
  6. Build an exterior wall section with a doorway.
  7. Install the door itself.
  8. Build a doorstep.
  9. Complete the roof.
  10. Craft and place a bed.
Before you move on
  • Window walls and windows have separate checks, as do doorway walls and doors. Check for missing pieces before using the roof-tracker recovery guide.

A Ride and a Revelation

Steps & preparation

Site-collected · interpreted game configuration, not fully play-tested

  1. Go to the NovaGen area.
  2. Complete the first conversation with Gigi.
  3. Speak with Chris.
  4. Speak with Gigi again.
  5. Enter Leafy Market.
  6. Buy more seeds. The condition checks a seed-category inventory count greater than two, not a purchase receipt.
  7. Take Gigi back to her ranch area.
  8. Complete the final goodbye conversation.
Before you move on
  • The objective order visits Leafy Market before the home drop-off, even though the introductory description mentions them in the opposite order.
  • The success configuration continues to Seed Capital.

Coop Dreams

Steps & preparation

Site-collected · interpreted game configuration, not fully play-tested

  1. Collect 15 stone.
  2. Collect 20 wood logs.
  3. Collect 15 hay.
  4. Have at least 5,760 C available.
  5. Buy the coop blueprint from Meriam.
  6. Finish building the coop.
  7. Visit Angela's ranch.
  8. Buy at least two hens; this check requires female chickens.
  9. Put two hens in the coop; ownership alone is not enough.
Before you move on
  • 5,760 C is a funds threshold, not a verified blueprint price or shopping total.
  • The overview mentions a rooster, but purchase and housing checks specifically require two hens.

Tame the Meter!

Steps & preparation

Site-collected · interpreted game configuration, not fully play-tested

  1. Open the phone's energy meter and inspect daily usage.
  2. Buy solar panel blueprints from Meriam for the panels you need.
  3. Place and finish building the panels.

Real Eggs, Real Evidence!

Steps & preparation

Site-collected · interpreted game configuration, not fully play-tested

  1. Collect two large chicken eggs from your coop.
  2. Meet Gigi and finish the first quest conversation.
  3. Lose the police pursuit.
  4. Return Gigi to her home area after escaping.
  5. Speak to Gigi again to finish the final conversation check.
Before you move on
  • The overview says 12 eggs, but both the objective and inventory check require 2 large chicken eggs. Follow the specific objective.
  • Returning home is not the last step: the final conversation and escape checks must both pass.
